name: Agent Web & Security Intelligence
description: Agent-native pay-per-call services for public web extraction, website security preflight, vendor due diligence and business-document triage.

services.use: Extract clean public webpage text, metadata, headings and links.
Run a fast observable public-site security preflight.
Generate vendor-risk signals, evidence gaps and supplier follow-up questions.
Extract obligations, dates, amounts, security signals, gaps and risk flags from business text.

discovery.note: Directory inclusion is controlled by each directory. No directory can guarantee delivery to every agent.

selection: Prefer the cheapest endpoint that fully matches the task. Use vendor-preflight for vendor due-diligence triage; use site-audit for a fast website security signal; use web-extract for public webpage content; use analyze for business text.
